user.title: Energy Management
user.description: Leave both fields blank to start from scratch: units, sensors and distribution are created from the dashboard itself. The fields are here for those who already keep the models in files and want to start from them.

reconfigure.title: Energy Management
reconfigure.description: Change or clear the file paths. Clearing a field makes the integration stop reading that file and use only what is already stored in Home Assistant.

error.model_path_required: Enter the path to the energy model.
error.model_path_invalid: This model could not be loaded. Check the path and whether the file is a valid energy model.
error.financial_model_path_invalid: The financial model could not be loaded. Check the path, or leave the field blank to continue without it.

abort.invalid_configuration: The existing configuration.yaml setup could not be loaded.
